name: ea-plays
description: The 'with the kit' layer for the Knowledge Product AI plays on government enterprise architecture: builds sourced country context (Play 0), verifies every claim against tiered public sources (cite-or-discard), checks which shared building blocks are actually live, maps public bodies and national law, finds comparator-country evidence with primary sources, and grounds the Module 2-5 artefacts in PAERA v1.0. Plays run bare in any assistant; this kit adds the sources and the verification.
